subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should one-way A2A handoff be added as an explicit `sessions_send` mode, a separate one-way primitive, or left outside core while preserving only the current conversation lifecycle?
rationale: The missing behavior is real in source, but the fix changes model-facing session semantics and could affect existing peer A2A workflows, so automation should not pick the permanent API shape.

options.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
options.body: Extend the existing `sessions_send` contract with an explicit one-way mode that preserves current conversation behavior as the default and adds focused docs/tests for both modes.

options.title: Create separate delivery primitive
options.body: Add a new `sessions_deliver` or `sessions_enqueue` style tool so dispatch cannot be confused with conversational `sessions_send`, at the cost of another model-facing tool surface.

options.title: Keep current lifecycle only
options.body: Treat reverse-call and announce issues as narrower bugs and decline a new one-way core API until a broader A2A design is accepted.

recommendation.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Extend the existing `sessions_send` contract with an explicit one-way mode that preserves current conversation behavior as the default and adds focused docs/tests for both modes.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to steipete as the strongest available owner for session docs, inter-session provenance, and A2A lifecycle decisions.
